name: cr715_3d_adventure_countered_goes_to_the_graveyard
why: CR 715.3d: exile replaces the graveyard only as the Adventure resolves; countered, it goes to its owner's graveyard, where Surgical Extraction can target it as the card it is again (CR 715.4), and no permission follows.
expect: Player A casts Petty Theft targeting Grizzly Bears
expect_not: Grizzly Bears is moved to hand
